description: Frame-interpolate a video with RIFE v4.26 (default x2, so 16 fps becomes 32 fps) and save an mp4. Fast: well under a minute for a 5 s clip. Audio is not kept.

video.help: Video to interpolate: path of an mp4 in the workspace, e.g. outputs/clip.mp4

multiplier.help: Frame multiplier. Default 2. Set fps to input fps times this.

fps.help: Output frame rate. Default 32 (16 fps input, multiplier 2). Keep it equal to input fps times multiplier so speed does not change.
